reference: Existing Intentic clay mascots and their gold lotus crown, used as visual style references.

assets.name: body-initial
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: modular persona-avatar BODY layer, production transparent PNG.
Reference image: existing Intentic clay mascot; use its soft rounded toy material, adorable oval body, two glossy dark eyes, tiny curved smile and stubby oval feet as style reference.
Primary request: Design the single reusable BODY for a mix-and-match avatar. Front-facing perfectly symmetric plump pear/egg-shaped clay companion. Entire body, feet and arms are neutral light gray clay (strictly achromatic; a grayscale texture for later color tinting). Dark charcoal eyes with white highlights and a tiny dark smile. NO blush. NO crown, jewelry, belt, ear ornaments or handheld object. The belly is fully exposed and smooth. NO hands crossing the belly: tiny arms stay attached on the far left and right outline, leaving the front completely empty so interchangeable large props can be layered over it. Separate mitten hands will be added later.
Composition: square 1024 x 1024 canvas, orthographic front view. Character centered. Body top at y=235, feet bottom y=950. Body spans x=185 through x=839. Eyes centered around y=440, smile at y=535. Leave the top 220px empty for a separate crown. Reserve belly y=580..835 for interchangeable props. Two stubby feet sit at x=385 and x=639. Entire character visible.
Materials: premium soft matte clay, very subtle fine texture, broad soft upper-left lighting, clean rounded shading, not photorealistic skin. Neutral grayscale only.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no backdrop, floor, ground shadow, text, watermark, border or checkerboard.
Preserve the reference's warmth and shape, while simplifying fine decorative details for legibility at 64px. Exactly one character.
assets.note: Intermediate reference for final body and hands; not shipped.

assets.name: body
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached grayscale mascot BODY layer. Change only one thing: REMOVE BOTH ARMS/HANDS from the left and right sides, smoothing the body silhouette behind them. This is an armless body layer; arms will be separate compositing assets. Keep exact same friendly face, eye positions, smile, body shape, two feet, material, strictly grayscale color, lighting, placement and canvas. Smooth rounded silhouette without side appendages. No gold, no props. Preserve real transparent background, no ground shadow. Output one standalone transparent PNG of the body and feet.

assets.name: crown
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference: the crown on the supplied mascot, style reference only. Asset type: single standalone crown layer for modular avatars. Render ONLY an elegant golden Khmer lotus/flame crown, NO character, body, face, hands, ears, belt or other object. Simplify the reference crown into five broad sculpted golden lotus petals, central petal taller, slightly curved bottom rim with a downward center tip. Orthographic FRONT VIEW. Soft matte brushed antique gold with bright upper-left highlights, soft depth and clean outline. Compact broad crown, width about 1.3 times height. Large centered object occupying about 80% of square canvas, fully visible with transparent margins. Real transparent alpha background. No floor, shadow outside object, text, watermark, labels, frame or checkerboard. High-quality soft clay toy illustration, readable as a crown at tiny UI scale.

assets.name: hands
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference: supplied neutral gray clay mascot, use its exact material, grayscale and light direction. Asset type: modular avatar foreground HANDS layer. Render ONLY a matched pair of two chubby short rounded neutral gray clay arms ending in simple mitten-like hands, floating side by side in a horizontal row. No character, body, head, feet, crown, jewelry or prop. Both forearms are horizontal capsules, wider at the outer ends and taper very slightly to rounded mitten fingertips pointing toward the center; no individual fingers, just subtle tiny thumb bumps on their upper inner edges. Left and right are mirror shapes, separate with a very wide empty transparent gap between them: each capsule is 24% of overall pair width, gap is 52%. Both share one baseline and same height, pair height 22% of overall pair width. They will overlay the left and right edges of a large prop so the mascot appears to hold it. Strictly achromatic light gray with soft upper-left lighting and smooth matte clay shading. Center pair on square canvas, occupy 86% canvas width, generous empty area above and below. Actual transparent alpha, no shadows outside shapes, no background, no text, no extra elements.

assets.name: terminal
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: interchangeable handheld PROP layer for a small friendly clay persona avatar.
Reference image: use the supplied crown only for its premium softly sculpted toy material, antique gold accents and upper-left studio lighting. DO NOT include the crown.
Render exactly ONE standalone object, no mascot, no hands, no human, no face or other objects. Orthographic nearly front view, slight sculpted depth, bold simple silhouette, broad clean surfaces, minimal detail so recognizable at 36–64px avatar size. Main accessory should be large and fill 82% of the square image's width or height, centered, entire object visible with generous alpha margin. Genuine transparent alpha background; no scene, floor, exterior cast shadow, text, labels, frame, watermark or checkerboard.

Subject: A chunky open miniature laptop. Very broad dark charcoal screen with thick softly rounded antique-gold bezel. On the screen only one VERY LARGE simple ivory terminal symbol >_ centered, nothing else. The ivory chevron and underscore are thick, taking most of the screen. A short thick gold keyboard deck extends forward at the bottom, with only a few shallow key shapes. Overall landscape silhouette, width 1.4 times height. Warm friendly rounded corners, gold rim contrasts strongly with black display.
